cat.title: CMU catalog 2025-2026 - Admission of international students

test_policy.notes: International page: 'The SAT or ACT test is optional but recommended'; students without scores may need math and English placement exams. The Common Data Set reports an open admission policy for all students and lists SAT/ACT as not required but considered if submitted.

requirements.notes: International file: online application with a $40 non-refundable fee (the brochure says a waiver code is available on request; a 'Free Application Week' banner was shown on the international page), official secondary transcript, proof of English proficiency, and for the I-20 the CMU Notarized Statement of Financial Support plus bank statements covering one year of costs (add $5,000 for a spouse and $4,000 per child). Health insurance is automatically billed through CMU's international group plan. No minimum GPA is published; the merit scholarship uses a U.S.-equivalent 3.0. The CDS lists essay, recommendations and interview as 'considered' only.

deadlines.label: International: fully admitted with I-20 issued (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The international page states that for fall an applicant must be fully admitted and have an I-20 issued by May 1 (visa appointment secured by Aug. 1); the page gives no year, so fall 2027 is assumed. Spring: admitted with I-20 by Oct. 1. Applicants who miss it defer to the next semester. Applying earlier is needed because the I-20 requires financial documents.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Minimum Reading and Writing subscores apply to TOEFL and IELTS, but the values are not printed on the pages read. Also accepted: Oxford ELLT minimum 6; completion of an approved intensive English program (pre-approved by the CMU International Student Admissions Office); full-time enrollment at a U.S. high school, college or university (case by case); other evidence case by case. Medium-of-instruction certificates are not accepted. Students below the minimums can apply for conditional admission to CMU and attend an approved intensive English provider (stated in the 2023-24 international brochure; not repeated on the current requirements page). PTE and Cambridge are not listed.

english.notes: Scores from before 2026 (the catalog also accepts 525 paper-based).
Updated 6-point scale, exams taken in 2026 and after (catalog: 'minimum average of 4').

aid.notes: CMU International Merit Scholarship: $9,000 per year ($4,500 per semester) for a U.S.-equivalent cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher (transfers 2.5), renewable for up to 9 semesters excluding summers. Returning International Student Scholarship: $1,000 per year after 30 CMU credits at a 3.75 GPA, combinable. The Common Data Set marks both need-based and non-need-based institutional aid as available to nonresidents, but CMU did not report the counts and amounts, and the international pages list only these merit awards.

sat.note: No SAT institution code is published on the international pages read; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: No ACT institution code is published on the admissions pages read; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is published on the international pages read; look it up in the ETS search.
